title: Air Conditioner Maintenance in Terrell Hills, TX
desc: If you're in need of an air conditioner maintenance in Terrell Hills, TX, call Rosenberg today to schedule service. We have AC tune-up plans!

blocks.text: Rosenberg Plumbing & Air has been providing air conditioner maintenance service in Terrell Hills, TX, for over 15 years. We recommend that everyone with property located in Bexar County get a yearly tune-up for their cooling units. Our team can provide this service no matter the unit’s make or model. This way, we can prevent costly breakdowns during the region’s hot summers.

items: Membership in the Air Conditioning Contractors of America

blocks.text: We’re licensed and insured for all we do, and our HVAC technicians are continually trained on advances in AC technology. We won the Quality Home Comfort Award in 2014 and the Angi Super Service Award in 2016.

You should know that even a brand-new unit can benefit from AC maintenance. This is where Rosenberg Plumbing & Air can help Terrell Hills residents. First of all, a tune-up can save money on future repairs by nipping in the bud any small issues that arise. It helps maintain a quiet, energy-efficient unit and keeps the utility bills down.

By signing up for our Comfort Club Membership, you can get even more benefits. First, we’ll remind you via email and postcard when your next tune-up will be. We can come over every spring for the job. Our tune-ups are thorough and take between 60 and 90 minutes to complete.

We’ll write up a detailed report of what we did and what we found wrong with your system. Terrell Hills residents can rest assured that we’ll cover all the basics of air conditioner maintenance. Our team will check the thermostat, filters, and belts. We’ll tighten any loose wiring, clean the condenser coils, lubricate the motor bearings, and blow out the condensate drain.

With Comfort Club Membership, you’ll receive a 15% discount on parts and labor whenever you need repairs. We also support our repair work with a one-year part and labor warranty. If you’re ever faced with an emergency, just know that we’re available 24/7/365 for repairs. You’ll be put first in line. In addition, all service fees are reduced by $20.

Rosenberg Plumbing & Air can provide air conditioner maintenance anywhere in Terrell Hills. We’re punctual in our arrival and always respectful of customers’ property. You can learn more through our office staff. Call us today.
Not looking for AC maintenance? We also offer AC installation and AC repair as well as heating maintenance.
